trap.label: conselho e suporte
trap.wrong: The printer is broken. If I would be you, I call IT. Did you try turn it off?
trap.right: The printer is broken. If I were you, I would call IT. Have you tried turning it off?
trap.why: Em português “se eu fosse você, ligaria” usa condicional. Em inglês: If I were you, I would. E try + -ing para testar, try to para tentar.

mcq.q: If I ___ you, I would call IT.

fix.wrong: If I was you, I would call.
fix.right: If I were you, I would call.

fix.wrong: Did you tried to turn it off?
fix.right: Did you try turning it off?
